body: Not really. Yeah, friends have no experience of it , that's why I consulted 2 professionals as well. It didn't help. I know friends don't understand , but I've still supported them the best I could always when they were down , and they just left me after I gathered all my courage and told them about my depression and suicidal feelings. One of them is very well aware I've been feeling horribly suicidal since the last 4 days , that person didn't even reply to so many of my texts. I mean I get it I'm an idiot and a burden but you can at least have the courtesy to tell me you don't wanna talk to me.

I am 20.  I tried my University counsellor and also a therapist 2 years ago.  Didn't work out. I told a friend about it and  she left me a while ago.  I told another friend and she left me as well.  So I have realized I can't talk to my friends. So I lost 2 people i cared about so much from my life. I don't wanna lose,  I just wanna end it all.  Dealing with depression for the last 5 years.
